title: Over 1,200 Students Take Part in Environmental Protection Training
author: Nguyen Tra
summary: In the training sessions, students learned about waste, its effects on daily life, and how to sort waste at home and at school. Notably, the program also guided students in applying STEM to environmental protection, letting them build hands-on models of recyclable-waste products.

contentBlocks.value: In the training sessions, students learned about waste, its effects on daily life, and how to sort waste at home and at school. Notably, the program also guided students in applying STEM to environmental protection, letting them build hands-on models of recyclable-waste products.

Due to the impact of the COVID-19 pandemic, the “Environmental Education” training program was the first program that students at both Giao Thuy Secondary School and Hai Ly Secondary School were able to attend in person since returning to school.

According to Nguyen Thi Cam Tu – Coordinator of Let's Do It Hanoi and Project Lead of the Green Ocean Campaign: “Organizing STEM environmental-protection training opens up new directions for students, sparking curiosity, creativity, and encouraging them to protect the environment. Being able to join in person with the students after a long period of online learning is a great opportunity for them to better understand the current state of environmental pollution, while also driving new scientific initiatives right within the local education environment.”

In addition to creating STEM environmental-protection products, students also took part in an inter-class competition, in which classes with products that best met the criteria of being recyclable, useful, and environmentally meaningful were awarded prizes.

The program was carried out as part of the Green Coastline Campaign organized by Let’s Do It Hanoi, aiming to raise community awareness of joining hands to protect the environment and contribute to a sustainable, environmentally friendly lifestyle, thereby transforming the state of Vietnam’s coastal environment.
